# Teachfloor

> Teachfloor is a collaborative social learning platform that enables organizations to create, deliver, and manage cohort-based courses and training programs with peer engagement and interactive learning experiences.

Teachfloor serves educational institutions, corporate training departments, and nonprofits with a flexible LMS that emphasizes social learning, peer assessment, and community building. The platform integrates with popular tools like Zoom, YouTube, Google Docs, and Miro to enhance collaborative learning experiences.

## Key Topics

- Social Learning
- Cohort-Based Courses
- Peer Learning & Assessment
- Collaborative Learning
- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Course Creation
- Student Engagement
- Community Building
- Online Learning
- Corporate Training
- Zoom Integration
- Interactive Learning

- Webhooks
